The main takeaway from our work is that

, when dealing with collections that are likely to overlap, quality estimation should be extended to take the amount of overlap between collections into account, in addition to the quality of the individual collections.
, when dealing with collections built by crawling the Web, the overlap among collections should be explicitly taken into account.
